title: Model Catalog Onboarding: Coordinated Launch Checklist and Release Notes Orchestration
creator: Asha Nair
description: Ticket to coordinate cross-functional tasks required to add a new model variant to the Redwood model catalog and execute a low-friction go-to-market launch. Focus areas: release notes and changelog, catalog metadata and benchmarks, docs and quickstarts, console rollout flags, SDK and API compatibility notes, partner/market comms. This ticket owns orchestration and signoffs; individual sub-tasks are tracked as sub_issues and dependencies.
checklist_items: Gather canonical model metadata: name, architecture, size, quantization variants, compatible runtime families, recommended batch sizes and sequence-length guidance
Complete benchmark runs: latency P50/P95 (single token and 1024-token sim), throughput at target batch sizes, memory footprint; attach CSVs and perf dashboard links
Create standardized release notes draft for internal and external audiences: highlight compatibility, quality differentiators, cost profile, known limitations and fallback guidance
Draft API/SDK migration notes and sample code for Node/Python/Go showing how to select the model and recommended flags
Console integration: create rollout flag, default visibility, and route mapping; coordinate with Console eng for dashboard tiles and observability hooks
Docs and Quickstart: write model-specific quickstart, prompt templates, and curated eval prompts for quality baseline
Release checklist: compliance review (if required), privacy/data handling summary, and KMS configuration guidance for Private deployments
Create customer-facing assets: blog draft, API changelog entry, release note snippet for the status page, and support KB article
Coordinate with Design for model card assets, sample prompts, and illustrative diagrams
Schedule canary rollout window with Dedicated/Private capacity teams and define rollback criteria
Update pricing/units guidance if new model impacts cost buckets and add to billing docs
Finalize internal launch email and triage plan for first 72 hours post-launch with on-call rotations
communication_plan: Internal pre-launch sync (PM/Eng/Design/Sales/Support) 72 hours prior: agenda + decision log
Publish release notes to docs.redwood.com and create a short summary for the developer newsletter
Coordinate Slack channel #product-launches and pin key links: benchmarks, PRs, dashboards, rollback runbook
Send partner update to channel partners with model compatibility matrix and expected GA date
Announce general availability with a blog post and social snippets; schedule AMA for developer community if impact is high
acceptance_criteria: Benchmarks uploaded and meet minimum performance thresholds agreed with runtime team
Release notes approved by PM, Eng lead, and Design; public docs and API changelog entries staged
Console tile and route mapping reviewed and merged; canary flag able to target 1-5% traffic
SDK samples included in repos and smoke-tested by SDK owners
Support KB and triage playbook published with expected error patterns and escalation path
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Performance regression on longer sequences. Mitigation: hold canary behind MSL (max sequence length) guard and run extended perf job before wider rollout
Risk: Unexpected token-cost increase for customers. Mitigation: include clear cost/unit guidance in release notes and enable cost telemetry for first 7 days
Risk: Compatibility break with older SDK versions. Mitigation: add compatibility check to release notes and provide fallbacks in SDKs
Risk: Console tile shows inaccurate latency due to metric name mismatch. Mitigation: validate observability anchors and run pre-launch smoke with sample traffic
